compare.title: What changes as RADR takes on more.

items.a: An annual subscription with a platform minimum, named locations and an agreed usage allowance. Your quote states the total and billing schedule. Onboarding and custom work are priced separately.
Register for the free fictional hotel or restaurant demo. A rollout with your own data is a separately scoped paid engagement.
Location coverage, operating priorities, source complexity, data volume, refresh frequency, processing and support requirements.
Onboarding is separately priced. Data mapping, training, custom integrations and historical backfill are itemized before work starts.
Core starts with one operating priority and named locations. Expand adds location comparisons and several agreed priorities. Enterprise addresses portfolio requirements.

items.q: What if our estate or usage grows?
items.a: Additional locations, usage or work require an approved scope and price change. The agreement defines how limits are handled.

items.q: Do you take a percentage of savings?
items.a: The standard model is a subscription. Modeled or expected savings do not create a charge.
The written agreement confirms fees, billing, start date, term, renewal, cancellation, support and delivery. No subscription starts by exploring this website.

readyLead: Tell us what you run, where margin disappears, and which systems hold the evidence. We will scope the right place to start.

progression.title: Core → Expand → Enterprise.
progression.lead: Compare operating scope, location coverage and portfolio requirements.
